# Ecclesiastes Chapter 11 -- The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**11:1** Send [shallach] your-bread [lachmekha] upon [al] the-face [penei] of-the-waters [ha-mayim], for in-many [be-rov] days [yamim] you-will-find-it [timtza'ennu].

**11:2** Give [ten] a-portion [cheleq] to-seven [le-shiv'ah] and-also [ve-gam] to-eight [li-shemonah], for you-do-not-know [ki lo teda] what evil [mah ra'ah] will-be [yihyeh] upon the-earth [al ha-aretz].

**11:3** If the-clouds [he-avim] are-full [yimmale'u] of-rain [geshem], upon the-earth [al ha-aretz] they-empty [yariku]; and-if a-tree [etz] falls [yippol] to-the-south [ba-darom] or to-the-north [im ba-tzafon] — the-place [meqom] where the-tree [ha-etz] falls [she-yippol], there [sham] it-will-be [yehu].

**11:4** The-one-who-watches [shomer] the-wind [ruach] will-not-sow [lo yizra], and-the-one-who-looks [ve-ro'eh] at-the-clouds [ba-avim] will-not-reap [lo yiqtzor].

**11:5** Just-as [ka-asher] you-do-not-know [einekha yode'a] what [mah] [is] the-way [derekh] of-the-wind [ha-ruach], like-bones [ka-atzamim] in-the-womb [be-veten] of-the-pregnant-woman [ha-male'ah] — so [kakha] you-cannot-know [lo teda] the-work [et ma'aseh] of-God [ha-Elohim] who makes [asher ya'aseh] everything [et ha-kol].

**11:6** In-the-morning [ba-boqer] sow [zera] your-seed [et zar'ekha], and-in-the-evening [ve-la-erev] do-not-rest [al tannach] your-hand [yadekha]; for you-do-not-know [ki einekha yode'a] which [ei zeh] will-prosper [yikhshar], whether-this [ha-zeh] or-that [o zeh], or-whether both-of-them [u-shneihem] alike [ke-echad] [will-be] good [tovim].

**11:7** And-sweet [u-matoq] [is] the-light [ha-or], and-good [ve-tov] for-the-eyes [la-einayim] to-see [lir'ot] the-sun [et ha-shamesh].

**11:8** For if [ki im] many [harbeh] years [shanim] the-human [ha-adam] lives [yichyeh], in-all-of-them [be-khullam] let-him-rejoice [yismach]; and-let-him-remember [ve-yizkor] the-days [et yemei] of-darkness [ha-choshekh] that they-will-be [ki yihyu] many [harbeh]. All [kol] that-comes [she-ba] [is] vapor [havel].

**11:9** Rejoice [semach], young-man [bachur], in-your-youth [be-yaldutekha], and-let-your-heart [vi-yitivekha libbekha] be-glad [in] the-days [bi-yemei] of-your-young-manhood [bechurotekha]; and-walk [ve-hallekh] in-the-ways [be-darkhei] of-your-heart [libbeka] and-in-the-sight [u-ve-mar'ei] of-your-eyes [einekha]; but-know [ve-da] that for-all-these [ki al kol eleh] God [ha-Elohim] will-bring-you [yevi'akha] into-judgment [ba-mishpat].

**11:10** And-remove [ve-haser] vexation [ka'as] from-your-heart [mi-libbeka], and-put-away [ve-ha'aver] evil [ra'ah] from-your-flesh [mi-besarekha]; for youth [ki ha-yaldut] and-the-dawn [ve-ha-shacharut] [are] vapor [havel].

---

## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1 — "bread upon the waters":** The meaning is debated. It may refer to maritime trade (send your goods overseas and eventually profit), to generosity (give freely, for it will return), or to the unpredictability of outcomes (act without knowing the result). EMET preserves the literal image without resolving the ambiguity.

**v.5 — "like bones in the womb":** The comparison of ignorance about the wind/spirit (*ruach*) to ignorance about fetal development is one of Qoheleth's most striking images. The double meaning of *ruach* (wind and spirit) creates a deliberate ambiguity.

**v.9 — "God will bring you into judgment":** This verse has been read as either Qoheleth's own qualification of his "enjoy life" advice or as an editorial addition. EMET presents the MT as received.

*-- EMET*
